The cases exercise hybrid JSFuck character reconstruction and hidden dispatch,
transparent pointer-following iframe overlays, and Facebook engagement abuse.
Visible and static Like widgets and ordinary character-code conversion are near
misses. Marketing eval is removed from the pointer fixture so that detection
must rest on the clickjacking mechanism. The coercion fixture constructs an
inert body; obfuscation is suspicious independently of payload intent.

The markup controls distinguish a real download attribute from a download word
inside a URL or another attribute; an HTMLView parameter from Blogger's
_HTMLView callback; and service endpoint references from product identity.

Neutral social-control atoms move from impact/social to ui/controls/widget.
Google API endpoint atoms move from google-web identity to HTTP services/google;
exact consumers retain their original matching scope. The ASX parameter matcher
moves to data/format/xml and now requires parameter markup. Script source loads
move to process/deploy and script-element creation to data/collection/dom;
these operations do not create OS processes. Exact consumers were updated;
no YAML parent selectors referenced the affected script/load homes. The redundant
traffic-objective script-injection atom is replaced with the existing neutral
script-loader matcher, extended to preserve its makefile/text scope. Other
members of the legacy directories are outside this sample's firing set.

The encoded-query URL atom and MsoNormalTable class observation are renamed to
remove unsupported AI-prompt and email claims. Existing computed-property-call
coverage extends to nested indices and inline HTML; its consumers still require
their own independent intent or product evidence.

Run `python3 testdata/triage/web-coercion/verify.py` from the repository root.
